item.title: Crafting a Research Paper: Insights from My Session at IIUC DSRG
item.description: On 28th January 2023, I conducted a research session on Beginning of a Researcher. This session was organized by IIUC Data Science Research Group In this session, I’ve discussed several fundamental components that a CS research paper must have. I’ve demonstrated how to organize those components properly in a research paper. Additionally, I also covered important guidelines for referencing and citation, as well as tips for making the paper visually appealing and easy to read.

item.title: The Persona in Pixels
item.description: Abu Nowhash Chowdhury received his B.Sc. (Engg.) in Computer Science and Engineering from the International Islamic University Chittagong, Bangladesh in 2022. Currently, he is serving as a Junior Instructor in Computer Science at the Asian University for Women. His principal research interest includes opinion mining from informal social media data, measuring the informativeness of user-generated texts, deep learning technologies, computational linguistics, and natural language processing (NLP). However, he is always interested in exploring other interdisciplinary research areas too.
